## Changelog v0.3.0
****Requires Fabric Language Kotlin & Fabric API****

### Changes
+Reworked replace mode to work server side (Completed #1)

+Added improved support for stairs in replace mode

+Fixed some branding issues

# Known issues
- Force Place updates block, if No Update is not enabled when placing a block next to a block with illegal placement
- Planned features are still missing
- This Mod does only work on 1.19.2. Updates to newer versions are planned, when all features are implemented, or I require it for other reasons, whatever comes first.
